purpose: Freeze candidate-vs-baseline equivalence judgment before any future run so baseline-collapse cannot be reinterpreted post hoc.

definitions.tie: candidate_score minus baseline_score is inside the pre-run frozen equivalence margin or the frozen statistical rule does not establish candidate advantage
definitions.candidate_equivalent: baseline ties candidate, beats candidate, or remains indistinguishable from candidate under the frozen equivalence rule on the primary heldout metric or required counterfactual metric
definitions.candidate_advantage: candidate exceeds the baseline on the primary heldout metric under the frozen equivalence rule and also satisfies all required heldout, counterfactual, leakage, replay, ablation, and provenance gates

minimum_rule.candidate_clears_faithful_baseline_only_: candidate exceeds that baseline on the primary heldout metric under the frozen equivalence rule
minimum_rule.ablation_drop_does_not_rescue_claim_if: any faithful non-oracle baseline still solves the task or is candidate-equivalent

pre_run_freeze_requirement.if_future_metric_is_not_yet_implemented: block implementation until the executable implementation card freezes a metric-specific equivalence margin or statistical rule before any run

hard_stops.condition: Future execution starts without a frozen equivalence rule.
The equivalence rule, margin, or statistical test differs from the pre-run frozen artifact.
Future result lacks equivalence rule hash or source pin.
Any faithful non-oracle baseline is candidate-equivalent under the frozen rule.

claim_ceiling: future equivalence judgment contract only; no metric, baseline, or experiment is implemented by this task
